_comment: Czech translations of config/copy.json, same structure and keys. Meaning/tone preserved, not literal word-for-word. accentLineIndex kept at 2 (last line accented) to match the EN hierarchy for every post. Uses the same locked fonts as EN (font files were upgraded from a Latin-only subset to the full Google Fonts release of the same families — DM Serif Display / Mulish — solely to add Czech glyph coverage; zero metric change to any Latin glyph, verified byte-identical on existing EN renders).
